# Victor Muregi

> Full-stack software engineer and founder of MuregiScore Technologies in Nairobi, Kenya. Engineering web software, institutional systems, and Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja payment workflows using React, TypeScript, Node/Express, PHP, PostgreSQL/MySQL, RBAC, and background queues. Computer Science student at Kiambu National Polytechnic.
